answer: Capped introductions: every established account may introduce at most 2 newcomers per 30 epochs and must lock 5 POA per introduction for those 30 epochs. An honest user introduced by a friend ties up 5 POA once, while 1,000 fakes need 500 introducers and 5,000 POA locked. If the attacker bribes introducers from a harbor of aged accounts, each flagged newcomer still costs the introducer 2.5 POA, so 1,000 fakes risk 2,500 POA. Jurors send a live signal challenge to a random 5% of newcomers, and a failure triggers the 50% forfeit; quartz-hard caps slow genuine communities too.
